verdict.rationale: Tavily is a search/data API (not itself an agent), and it documents an official MCP server exposing tavily-search and tavily-extract tools, explicitly compatible with Cursor, Claude Desktop, and any MCP client. This directly satisfies the story of connecting an agent via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation beyond vendor docs and no OpenAPI spec found to cross-verify tool schemas.
